title: My Hero Academia Confirms New U.S. Release After Anime’s Finale
content: Written and illustrated by Kohei Horikoshi, My Hero Academia is one of the most popular Shonen anime and manga franchises of all time. Although the manga reached its conclusion in 2024, the series keeps returning with new projects and releases for fans.

title: 'Romelia Senki' Reveals Additional Cast, First Promo for Fall 2026
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ryou Ariyama 's Romelia Senki ( Romelia War Chronicle ) light novel revealed additional cast and first promotional video on Friday. The anime series will run for two cours on Tokyo MX, BS11, Sun TV, and KBS Kyoto in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Isekai Tensei Soudouki' Unveils Additional Cast, Main Staff, First Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ryousen Takami 's Isekai Tensei Soudouki ( Multi-Mind Mayhem ) novel unveiled additional cast, the main staff, the first key visual (pictured), and first promotional video on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, July 27-August 2
content: This week's episode of the new live-action series based on Tohru Fujisawa 's GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka manga aired on Fuji TV on Monday, July 27 at 10:00 p.m. and earned a 4.8% rating.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action 'Chotto Matō yo, Harutora-kun' BL Series' Trailer Previews Ending Song
content: MBS presented a new trailer for the live-action series of Amekiri 's Chotto Matō yo, Harutora-kun (Wait a second, Harutora-kun) boys-love manga on Friday. The trailer reveals and previews the series' ending theme song "Honeyy" by Chihiro.
author: ANN

title: Shueisha Launches Manga Million Platform in Tagalog, English
content: Japanese publishing company Shueisha announced on Thursday that it has launched its global digital manga platform " MANGA MILLION " in Tagalog and English, among other languages. The application has over one million pages of translated manga from 400 titles at launch.
author: ANN
